== Biography ==
Alexander was born abt 1846 in Glasgow, Lanarkshire, Scotland. His parents were probably Alexander Glasgow and Mary.

Alexander Glasgow, approximately 5 years old, was documented as the son of Alexander Glasgow and Mary Glasgow. His estimated birth year is around 1846, and he was born in Glasgow, Lanark. The family resided at 167 Main Street in Calton, Lanarkshire. Alexander in 1851 when he was a scholar by occupation at this young age.<ref>"1851 Scotland Census," database, ({{Ancestry Record|1076|1867762}} : accessed 25 January 2024), Alexander Glasgow (5) son, Scholar, in household of Alexander Glasgow (38) at 167 Main Street, Calton, Lanarkshire. Born in Glasgow, Lanark; citing Parish Calton, ED 22A, Page 14, Line 16, Roll CSSCT1851_147, Year 1851, Household schedule number 56, Roll CSSCT1851_147.

In 1861 Alexander, age 15, was the son of Alexander Glasgow at 99 Dalmarnock Road, Glasgow Calton, Lanarkshire. == Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2822]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The held 1851 and 1861 census abstracts explicitly call young Alexander son of Alexander at 167 Main Street and 99 Dalmarnock Road. The older man's age and flesher trade agree across both households and the son's apprentice-butcher career.

Selected Glasgow-2822 fatherhood of Glasgow-1587; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare original census and 1870 marriage father occupation.

No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


[[Bicket-53|Elizabeth (Bicket) Glasgow (abt.1818-abt.1866)]] was incorrectly linked to profile as wife. Marriage of Elizabeth Bicket states that she was 42 and Alexander was 48, which is not consistent with Alexander's age on this profile. It also states that Alexander's parents were Robert and Margaret. That Elizabeth now has a death source in 1866 with Bicket and Glasgow as last names.  It is possible that she married Alexander's father [[Glasgow-951|Alexander Glasgow (1813-)]] instead.

As stated in the profile, with source now added, he married Lizzie Brownlie. Lizzie (Brownlie) Glasgow, age 52, died in 1898. The death was registered in Kelvin. Mother's maiden name was Letham.<ref>"Statutory Register of Deaths," database, National Records of Scotland, ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 25 January 2024), Lizzie Brownlie death registered 1898 in Kelvin (age 52, mother's maiden name Letham); citing Ref 644/9/757.</ref>  Birth would be abt 1846, which is consisten with 1871 census
